rules_learned: RULE 1 (Two-Sided Opponent Audit): Never predict total fouls/cards from one team's average alone. Blend 50% Team A + 50% Team B.
RULE 2 (Clean Opponent Veto): If either team commits <=9.0 fouls/game or <=1.3 cards/game, VETO Over 22.5 Fouls and Over 3.5 Cards; pivot to Under Fouls/Cards.

RULE 3 (Trailing Team Siege Corner Explosion): When a dominant possession favourite trails or is held 0-0/1-2 (Getafe 15 corners vs Lugano, Freiburg 11 corners vs Monaco, Olympiacos 14 corners vs Sparta), corners explode to 15-20. VETO Under Corners.

RULE 4 (Away Underdog Fouls Surge): When a central/southern European underdog visits or hosts an elite side in a tight 1-goal game (Lugano 23 fouls, Sturm Graz 23 fouls, Thun 23 fouls), underdog fouls surge +35%.
RULE 5 (Possession Sterility vs Low Block): High possession away favourites (Brighton 64% at Jablonec) can be held to 0-0 with <10 corners if the host plays a passive 5-4-1.
RULE 6 (Card Conversion Dampener): High fouls (24-26) only convert to 4+ cards if referee cards/foul ratio >= 0.16 (Juventus vs Rennes had 24 fouls -> only 2 cards).

RULE 7 (Clinical Central Transition Corner Trap): Teams that score through direct central transitions with low crosses (Liverpool 6-3 LASK -> 6 corners; Club Brugge 3-0 Lens -> 1 Brugge corner on 6 crosses, 6 total corners) fail Over 9.5 Corners even when pre-match corner averages look high. Require high crosses/g (>=16/g) before backing Over 9.5 Corners.

RULE 8 (Heavy Favourite <= 1.45 Blowout Corner Ban -> SOT Pivot): Filter #2 saved 2 more losses on Wednesday UCL (Inter 1-0 Shakhtar had 9 corners despite Forebet Over 9.74; Real Madrid 4-1 Leipzig had 8 corners despite Forebet Over 10.43) while the Favourite Over 4.5 SOT pivot went 3/4 on Wednesday (Inter 5, Real Madrid 11, Aston Villa 10; Sporting 4 on 16 shots & 3.16 xG) and is now 15/16 (93.8%) overall!

RULE 9 (Shock Underdog Lead Foul Spike): 0 points in the table does NOT cause high fouls (Lille vs Gala 19 fouls, Inter vs Shakhtar 19 fouls). High fouls in mismatches ONLY occur when a huge underdog (>= 6.00 odds, like LASK @ 11.00 leading 3-1 at Sporting CP) takes a shock lead and commits 20+ tactical/time-wasting fouls (LASK 22 fouls, 5 yellows) parking the bus.
